BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced on May 21, 2026, that it purchased 781,470 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of its share buyback program. The purchases were made at prices ranging from 864.0000 to 883.0000 pence per share, with a volume-weighted average price of 872.7080 pence per share. Sage intends to cancel all repurchased shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 21 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 21 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 781,470 Highest price paid per share: 883.0000 Lowest price paid per share: 864.0000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 872.7080 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
